what: The first loader, which buries one name line in the middle of five lines of filler letters and then filters it out. The filler letters come in from 120% on the left in random order (within .75s) over 1s power2.out, and the name letters stand up .25s later at .035s intervals. After holding .4s, only the filler letters fade to a pale color over .95s, and .25s later they exit to 120% on the right in random order (within .35s) over 1.15s power2.inOut. During this, the gap letter slots between the name narrow to .48em and the end letter slot to 0 over 1.25s, so the name closes up. .5s later the name also exits to the right at .02s intervals over .85s, and .35s after that fx:done fires

options.rows: Number of lines (including the name line, name in the center), default 5
options.len: Characters per text line, default 18 (even lines +2)
options.gap · trail: Any number of characters to insert between and after names, default 3 · 2
options.close: Gap (em) left after the names are brought closer, default .48
options.hold: Hold before fading once fully in (s), default .4
options.seed: Random character pick seed — the same number always gives the same character, default 763
options.--fx-dim · --fx-cover · --fx-size · --fx: Faded text color, panel background, text size (phone --fx-size-sm) and stacking (via style). Defaults --kf-line · --kf-bg · 34px (phone 20px) · 10000
options.[data-fx-part=brand]: Required name text — split into two chunks: the first word and the rest
options.fx:done: When even the names are all gone, an event that bubbles up from the element. The board background is emptied, so hook the veil removal laid behind it (fx:ink-play of ink-paper-veil) here

from.where: shared.js .eg-loader (original page-loader — five lines of 18 · 20 · name · 18 · 18 characters, name line is first name + gap 3 + last name + tail 2, faded color #e6e6e6)
